<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$blog_id = get_current_blog_id();
$site_url = get_site_url( $blog_id );
$site_url_parts = parse_url( $site_url );
$data = [ $site_url_parts['host'], $blog_id ];
if ( isset( $site_url_parts['path'] ) ) {
	$data[] = $site_url_parts['path'];
}
$uid = md5( implode( '-', $data ) );
update_option( 'cimo_activation_data', [
	'status' => 'activated',
	'install_id' => 'e2e-install-id',
	'activation_params' => [
		'uid' => $uid,
		'license_key' => 'e2e-license-key',
	],
	'install_data' => [
		'license_plan_name' => 'premium',
		'install_public_key' => 'e2e-public',
		'install_secret_key' => 'e2e-secret',
	],
], false );
